ground.value: stationary no-slip floor; no moving-ground condition

wheels.value: not applicable; Ahmed body has no wheels

solver.value: OpenFOAM v2212 pimpleFoam, transient incompressible flow

averaging.details: Paper v1 says 40 CTU total with averaging after 10 CTU; pinned dataset README says approximately 80 CTU. Exact per-run window is unresolved.

force_axes.value: published Cd=Fx and Cl=Fz coefficient definitions; labels copied without sign changes

provenance.description: AhmedML high-fidelity CFD geometry variants; published labels are simulation outputs, not experimental truth.
provenance.source_setup: OpenFOAM v2212, pimpleFoam, SA-DDES; the pinned dataset README describes approximately 80 CTU, while paper v1 describes 40 CTU total with averaging after 10 CTU.
provenance.reynolds_definition: U_infinity * full STL body length / nu; U=1 m/s and nu=3.75e-7 m^2/s from the paper.
provenance.geometry_orientation: Raw STL X is body length with the rounded nose at negative X; raw Z is up and raw Y is lateral, confirmed from the official coordinate bounds and body profile.
provenance.geometry_clearance: The paper states 50 mm clearance above the floor; source STL vertical coordinates are normalized to that documented floor distance during rendering.
provenance.yaw_representation: AhmedML uses zero yaw; the source geometry is rendered in its documented body frame.
condition_limitations: The published paper and pinned README disagree on total averaging duration.
The surface mesh is the simplified Ahmed body; it has no wheels or experimental stilts.

ground.value: stationary no-slip ground plane; a ground boundary layer grows; per-run body clearance is a published geometry parameter

wheels.value: no wheels in the dataset baseline geometry

turbulence.value: wall-modeled LES with Vreman subgrid model and equilibrium wall model

solver.value: Volcano ScaLES, transient compressible Navier-Stokes with explicit SSP Runge-Kutta 3 integration

averaging.details: The paper says outputs are time averaged but does not report the averaging start or duration for the dataset.

force_axes.value: published yawed-model-axis coefficients Cd=Fx, Cl=Fy, Cs=Fz with y up; these are not freestream-projected components at nonzero yaw and labels are copied unchanged

provenance.description: WindsorML wall-modeled LES geometry variants; published labels are simulation outputs, not experimental truth.
provenance.source_setup: Volcano ScaLES transient compressible Navier-Stokes WMLES; nominal inlet speed 40 m/s, Reynolds number 2.9e6 based on full body length, and published body rotation -2.5 degrees about raw +Y.
provenance.reynolds_definition: U_infinity * full STL body length / nu; nu is derived from the paper's U=40 m/s, Re=2.9e6 and baseline full-body length 1.044 m.
provenance.geometry_orientation: Raw X is the longitudinal axis with front at negative X; raw Y is up and raw Z is lateral. The floor-referenced STL includes the four support stilts that reach Y=0.
provenance.geometry_clearance: The published clearance design parameter varies from 10 to 200 mm and is retained in each design_value row. The full STL already places support feet at the floor and the body underside at its reported clearance; no clearance offset is added during rendering.
provenance.yaw_representation: The paper rotates the body by -2.5 degrees about raw +Y while the tunnel flow is along raw +X. In the fixed body frame the inverse-rotated freestream points toward canonical +Y, so yaw_deg is +2.5 degrees; the published body rotation is -2.5 degrees.
condition_limitations: The paper does not state the time-averaging start or duration for the dataset labels.
The source STL includes floor-reaching support stilts; its per-run body clearance is already present in the mesh.
Published Cd, Cl and Cs are source-axis force components, not freestream-projected coefficients.
